title: Value-oriented policy distillation for interpretable wind farm power control
abstract: arXiv:2611.08245v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Wind farm power control can help the system maintain balance and avoid blackouts. In Europe, this can be achieved through implicit balancing, where a wind farm adjusts its power setpoint in anticipation of the imbalance price using information published by the Transmission System Operator. Thereby, the wind farm helps restore system balance while also reducing its own imbalance costs resulting from forecast errors. However, implicit balancing is a challenging problem since the settlement price is unknown in advance and can be impacted by the pursued control strategy. Reinforcement learning methods could help to solve this problem, but lack the interpretability needed to be deployed on real wind farms. Therefore, we propose a policy distillation framework using explainable boosting machines (EBMs), a variant of generalized additive models, to obtain a transparent control policy. translated_title: 面向价值的策略蒸馏方法用于可解释的风电场功率控制
translated_abstract: 风电场功率控制可以帮助系统维持平衡并避免停电。在欧洲，这可以通过隐式平衡来实现，即风电场利用输电系统运营商发布的信息，在预判不平衡价格的基础上调整其功率设定点。通过这种方式，风电场既有助于恢复系统平衡，又能降低自身因预测误差而产生的不平衡成本。然而，隐式平衡是一个具有挑战性的问题，因为结算价格事先未知，并且可能受到所采用的控制策略的影响。强化学习方法有助于解决这一问题，但缺乏在真实风电场上部署所需的可解释性。因此，我们提出了一种基于可解释提升机（EBMs，广义可加模型的一种变体）的策略蒸馏框架，以获得透明的控制策略。为了提升EBM模型所捕获的价值，我们引入了……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种面向价值的策略蒸馏框架，利用可解释提升机（EBM）将强化学习策略蒸馏为透明可解释的控制策略，从而实现风电场的隐式平衡功率控制。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a value-oriented policy distillation framework that uses explainable boosting machines (EBMs) to distill reinforcement learning policies into transparent, interpretable control policies for wind farm implicit balancing power control.
